listenings.text: Thank you for calling the City Museum. Please listen to this message, because it answers most questions. We are open from Tuesday to Sunday, from ten in the morning until five in the afternoon. On Sunday we close earlier, at three. We are closed all day on Monday, and we are also closed on the first of January and the twenty-fifth of December. The last entry is always thirty minutes before we close, so on a normal day that is half past four, and on Sunday it is half past two. A visit takes about two hours with children. If you come with a group of more than ten people, please call us in the morning, between nine and ten. To speak to a person, stay on the line. Thank you.

Hello, this is a message about your bus tour on Thursday. I am sorry, but we have to change the time. The tour was at half past two, and now it starts at four o'clock, because of the traffic in the centre in the afternoon. The tour is still one hour and twenty minutes, so you finish at twenty past five. The meeting point is the same, in the square. If four o'clock is not good for you, we have two other options: Thursday at ten in the morning, or Friday at the same time, half past two. Please call us before Wednesday evening and tell us what you prefer. If we do not hear from you, we keep you on Thursday at four. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Good morning. What time do you open, please? And what time do you close? Are you open on Sunday? Can I book for Tuesday morning? Thank you very much.

paras: Welcome to the City Museum. Please read our opening hours before you come, because they are not the same every day.
We are open from Tuesday to Saturday, from ten in the morning until five in the afternoon. On Sunday we open at ten too, but we close earlier, at three.
We are closed all day on Monday. We are also closed on the first of January and on the twenty-fifth of December.

The last entry is always thirty minutes before we close. A normal visit takes about two hours, and about one hour if you come only for the top floor. Children under twelve do not pay. If you come with a group of more than ten people, please call in the morning, between nine and ten.
